name: Wind-Down Yoga Flow
equipment: A bed or mat, and comfortable clothing
instructions: Move through a short, slow flow that connects breath and movement -- this is about downshifting, not stretching hard.
Keep transitions unhurried; there is no benefit to moving quickly through a wind-down sequence.
Let your exhales get slightly longer than your inhales as you go, a simple way to cue your body toward rest.
Follow tonight's wind-down yoga video as your last activity of the day, then go straight to bed.
